rules: The 23 QA flags record comparison differences, not 23 lost owner approvals
Title normalization or station numbering does not in itself authorize a new canonical object ID
Princeton and Geneva Visitation paintings are distinct works, and must not be silently swapped
Follower/workshop/copy attributions take priority over ambiguous artist display names for newly generated metadata
Retain original owner-selected current artwork and all accepted alternatives
Photographer, uploader and scan/poster authorship must be separated from artwork creator
All image rights, exact source bytes and phone crop gates remain closed
